caption:
Seven small swaps for your mornings this week.

Grey November mornings make it very easy to stay in bed until the last second, grab a coffee and run. These seven take about 10 minutes all together.

Number 5 is the easiest win. Stepping outside while the kettle boils gets daylight into your eyes early, and morning light is the main signal your body clock uses to set the rest of the day.

Number 7 surprises people. UVA rays, the ones linked to skin ageing, come through cloud all year round, so SPF still earns its place in November.

Save this for tomorrow morning, and send it to the friend who hits snooze five times.
